card.name: After a person's name in news text
card.fires_on: The word or mark right after a named person in web news or education text, such as a byline, a credit line, or a name followed by 'has' or a comma.

modes.label: Verb after a name
modes.description: The word 'has' right after a person's full name that starts a sentence.
modes.example: Vince Gallagher<< has>> a look at what went on.

modes.label: Byline or credit
modes.description: A space or comma right after a author or photo credit name.

modes.label: Comma before a job title
modes.description: A comma after a name that is followed by a role or institution.
modes.example: Charlotte Berry<<,>> Assistant Headteacher, Billericay School

card.plain: It fires on the spot just after a person's name in a news story, byline or credit.
